description:
In-game settings for TF3-DLSS5, the DLSS / FSR 3.1 add-on for Transport Fever 3 on Windows.

IMPORTANT: this mod is only the menu. The upscaler is a separate Windows download (free, open source):
https://github.com/shimataa/TF3-DLSS5/releases/latest
Without it, or on a console, Mac or Linux, the buttons do nothing.

Adds a D5 button at the top left of the screen, next to the Layers button: Upscaler ON/OFF, DLSS 5 ON/OFF, sharpness, info box. Each change is written to the game log (stdout.txt); the add-on reads it, applies it within a second and keeps it. Your saves are not changed; the mod can be added and removed at any time.

Unofficial; not affiliated with Urban Games, NVIDIA or AMD. NVIDIA and DLSS are trademarks of NVIDIA Corporation.
name: TF3-DLSS5 Menu
summary: In-game DLSS settings for the TF3-DLSS5 Windows add-on (separate download). Menu only: does nothing without the add-on.
